postTitle: I don't like this game, or the FNAF series. Hear me out.
postSubject: Hello all, if you are clicking on this, you obviously have a bone to pick with me for not liking something you like, and that's perfectly fine, I would do the same. The following text is all my opinion. So if you disagree  with it, try to respect it, alright?1. They are point and click games. I never liked them, it is sometimes unresponsive and when things get crazy, I have to get jumpy with my hand.2. They aren't that scary, not even FNAF 4. It's played out like jumpscares are the scariest things. If you want a good experience, watch Alien or Aliens. I highly recommend them.3. They lack replay value. Yes, I know about custom night, but it's pointless as once you do the maximum difficulty, it's pointless.4. The lore. A lot of people seem to think this game has thrillingand deep lore. I disagree. I think this lore is pretty shallow. If you want a game series with good lore, try out Metal Gear Solid. I recommend Snake Eater. It deals  with censorship, living  your life, national conspiracies, giving up everything for your country.5. The fanbase. Oh, the fanbase. Yes, I know, every fanbase has their bad parts, just look at MLP, Sonic, or Undertale (I am not calling any of them bad at all. I don't watch MLP or played Undertale, but I am a Sonic fan.) This fanbase has few good and a lot of bad. The bad: Fanart, fanfiction, theories (Yes, I'm including Game Theory as they have gone downhill.) and the shipping. Plus the people who hate on others for having a diffent opinion. I mean, just look at the inevitable comments on THIS thread!Anyways, for proof. I have played and beaten all the games (Besides FNAF World) on a friends account.I hope you can respect my opinionIf you made it to the end, congrats!
commentSubject: I'm not going to delete the topic, but I did ban the user, only because so much of his post was dedicated to trashing the fan base. Who honestly goes to another game's page just to trash the fan base? :P
